originality_claim: No unique, first-use, or exclusive claim is made. The proposal is evaluated as a specific planning combination of separated public service and research-operations interfaces, a staffed publicly accessible service area, and a closure boundary that preserves ordinary public access. Site rights, frontage feasibility, and semantic originality remain subject to professional and human review.

corpus_scan.method: Repository-wide keyword screen of every primary proposal, followed by human semantic comparison of the retained nearest candidates.

screened_manual_review_notes.review: Shares public service continuity, human fallback, stop and exit logic. Its core is a probe-and-evidence framework rather than a repeated public/staffed/operations section; no exclusivity is claimed over the shared governance ground.

Uses digital and human service entrances and preserves ground service when low-altitude operations stop. The two entrances serve channel choice rather than the public-versus-equipment spatial separation used here; shutdown continuity remains shared.

Closely overlaps through an open-station type with dual entrances, a public front, controlled middle space, equipment back-of-house, and stoppable computation. This proposal therefore makes no unique claim over dual entrances or front-middle-back separation.

Closely overlaps through same-channel AI and human/static access, staffed service, non-AI baselines, time windows, stopping and retirement. The distinct emphasis there is temporal adoption; ordinary-service continuity is shared.

Closely overlaps through public routes that remain open beside controlled testing, separate public and logistics entrances, human takeover and stoppable equipment. Its shaft system and proof protocol differ; basic spatial separation is shared.

The closest new collision: a continuous ordinary/non-AI route remains during intermittent AI validation, failure and recovery, supported by staffed handover. This submission does not claim that principle as original and limits its proposed increment to a compact, repeated two-state public-ground-floor section tied to thirteen scenario records.

corpus_scan.scope_note: Screening covers the frozen upstream primary Chinese proposal for every submission. English counterparts were not double-counted as separate proposals.
